# 聊天页

不用 Page 的全屏聊天界面：贴边的 SplitView，左侧是会话列表，右侧是 MessageList 与 PromptInput。回复以 Markdown 从模拟的模型流式输出，可以停止、复制、评价与重试；新会话显示 PromptSuggestions。含有「error」的消息会在中途失败。

**用到的组件**: [Avatar](../components/Avatar.md), [Box](../components/Box.md), [Button](../components/Button.md), [Heading](../components/Heading.md), [Icon](../components/Icon.md), [ListItem](../components/ListItem.md), [Markdown](../components/Markdown.md), [Message](../components/Message.md), [MessageActions](../components/MessageActions.md), [MessageList](../components/MessageList.md), [PromptInput](../components/PromptInput.md), [PromptSuggestions](../components/PromptSuggestions.md), [SplitView](../components/SplitView.md), [Stack](../components/Stack.md), [Text](../components/Text.md), [useStream](../components/useStream.md)

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import {
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Heading,
  Icon,
  ListItem,
  Markdown,
  Message,
  MessageActions,
  type MessageFeedback,
  MessageList,
  type MessageListHandle,
  type MessageStatus,
  PromptInput,
  type PromptSuggestion,
  PromptSuggestions,
  SplitView,
  Stack,
  Text,
  useStream,
} from 'vellum-ui'

interface Turn {
  readonly id: string
  readonly author: 'user' | 'assistant'
  /** Plain text for the user, Markdown for the assistant. */
  readonly text: string
  readonly status: MessageStatus
}

interface Conversation {
  readonly id: string
  readonly title: string
  /** When the conversation last changed, as shown in the list. */
  readonly updated: string
  readonly turns: readonly Turn[]
}

const PLAN = `Here is a plan for the launch week:

1. **Monday**: freeze the scope and share the final list with the team.
2. **Tuesday**: run the release checklist; anything \`blocked\` moves to the next sprint.
3. **Wednesday**: publish the release notes and brief the support team.
4. **Thursday**: launch, then watch the error rate and the sign-ups.
5. **Friday**: collect feedback and plan the first fixes.

> Ship small, ship often.`

const SUMMARY = `The design review agreed on three changes:

| Topic | Decision | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Navigation | Keep the sidebar, remove the top tabs | Sam Lee |
| Colors | One accent color for every action | Riley Chen |
| Empty states | Explain the next step in each of them | Jordan Park |

Open question: whether the dashboard needs a compact density.`

const UPDATE = `**Status update, week 45**

- The new onboarding is live for 20% of the sign-ups.
- Page load time is down from 2.4 s to 1.6 s.
- Next week: the billing settings and the export of reports.

Let me know if you want it shorter for the newsletter.`

const CONVERSATIONS: readonly Conversation[] = [
  { id: 'c3', title: 'New chat', updated: 'Now', turns: [] },
  {
    id: 'c2',
    title: 'Summarize the design review',
    updated: 'Yesterday',
    turns: [
      { id: 'c2-1', author: 'user', text: 'Summarize the design review', status: 'done' },
      { id: 'c2-2', author: 'assistant', text: SUMMARY, status: 'done' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'c1',
    title: 'Plan the launch week',
    updated: 'Monday',
    turns: [
      { id: 'c1-1', author: 'user', text: 'Plan the launch week', status: 'done' },
      { id: 'c1-2', author: 'assistant', text: PLAN, status: 'done' },
    ],
  },
]

const STARTERS: readonly PromptSuggestion[] = [
  { key: 'plan', label: 'Plan the launch week', icon: 'calendar' },
  { key: 'summary', label: 'Summarize the design review', icon: 'file-text' },
  { key: 'update', label: 'Draft a status update', icon: 'message' },
]

function answerFor(prompt: string): string {
  const text = prompt.toLowerCase()
  if (text.includes('plan') || text.includes('launch')) return PLAN
  if (text.includes('summar') || text.includes('review')) return SUMMARY
  if (text.includes('update') || text.includes('status')) return UPDATE
  return `Here is what I can help with:\n\n- Plans and checklists, such as **a launch week**\n- Summaries of notes and reviews, often as a table\n- Drafts of updates and announcements\n\nTry one of them, or ask about "${prompt.slice(0, 60)}" in more detail.`
}

function wait(ms: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (signal.aborted) return reject(signal.reason)
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
    const onAbort = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer)
      reject(signal.reason)
    }
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort)
      resolve()
    }, ms)
    signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true })
  })
}

async function* fakeModel(prompt: string, signal: AbortSignal): AsyncGenerator<string> {
  await wait(700, signal)
  const answer = answerFor(prompt)
  const fails = /\berror\b/i.test(prompt)
  for (let i = 0; i < answer.length; i += 5) {
    if (fails && i >= 120) throw new Error('The connection was reset')
    await wait(30, signal)
    yield answer.slice(i, i + 5)
  }
}

const titleOf = (text: string) => (text.length > 40 ? `${text.slice(0, 40).trim()}…` : text)

export function ChatPage() {
  const listRef = useRef<MessageListHandle>(null)
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState(CONVERSATIONS)
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState('c3')
  // The reply that is streaming, or has just finished, and the conversation it belongs to
  const [live, setLive] = useState<{
    readonly conversationId: string
    readonly id: string
    readonly prompt: string
  } | null>(null)
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<Readonly<Record<string, MessageFeedback>>>({})
  const reply = useStream({
    request: (signal, prompt: string) => fakeModel(prompt, signal),
    initial: '',
    reduce: (text: string, chunk: string) => text + chunk,
  })

  /** Moves the live reply into its conversation, so that another one can start. */
  const commit = () => {
    if (!live || reply.status === 'idle') return
    const turn: Turn = {
      id: live.id,
      author: 'assistant',
      text: reply.value,
      // A reply that is left while it streams is stopped
      status: reply.status === 'streaming' ? 'stopped' : reply.status,
    }
    setConversations((list) =>
      list.map((c) => (c.id === live.conversationId ? { ...c, turns: [...c.turns, turn] } : c)),
    )
    setLive(null)
    reply.reset()
  }

  const send = (text: string) => {
    commit()
    const id = `t${Date.now()}`
    setConversations((list) =>
      list.map((c) =>
        c.id === activeId
          ? {
              ...c,
              title: c.turns.length === 0 ? titleOf(text) : c.title,
              updated: 'Now',
              turns: [...c.turns, { id: `${id}-q`, author: 'user', text, status: 'done' }],
            }
          : c,
      ),
    )
    setLive({ conversationId: activeId, id: `${id}-a`, prompt: text })
    reply.start(text)
    listRef.current?.scrollToEnd()
  }

  const retry = () => {
    if (live) reply.start(live.prompt)
  }

  const open = (id: string) => {
    commit()
    setActiveId(id)
  }

  const newChat = () => {
    commit()
    const id = `c${Date.now()}`
    setConversations((list) => [{ id, title: 'New chat', updated: 'Now', turns: [] }, ...list])
    setActiveId(id)
  }

  const active = conversations.find((c) => c.id === activeId)
  const liveTurns: Turn[] =
    live && live.conversationId === activeId && reply.status !== 'idle'
      ? [{ id: live.id, author: 'assistant', text: reply.value, status: reply.status }]
      : []
  const items = [...(active?.turns ?? []), ...liveTurns]
  const generating = liveTurns.length > 0 && reply.status === 'streaming'

  const renderTurn = (m: Turn, index: number) => {
    if (m.author === 'user') return <Message author="user">{m.text}</Message>
    // Only the live reply can be generated again; the actions of the latest reply are always visible
    const isLive = m.id === live?.id
    return (
      <Message
        author="assistant"
        name="Assistant"
        avatar={<Avatar name="Assistant" icon="sparkles" size={28} />}
        status={m.status}
        onRetry={isLive ? retry : undefined}
        showActions={index === items.length - 1 ? 'always' : 'hover'}
        actions={
          <MessageActions
            copyText={m.text}
            onRetry={isLive ? retry : undefined}
            feedback={feedback[m.id] ?? null}
            onFeedbackChange={(f) => setFeedback((all) => ({ ...all, [m.id]: f }))}
          />
        }
      >
        {m.text && <Markdown content={m.text} streaming={m.status === 'streaming'} />}
      </Message>
    )
  }

  return (
    // A full-screen interface: no Page; the split view fills the height that the application gives it
    <SplitView
      variant="flush"
      aside={
        <Stack gap={1} padding={2}>
          <Button block icon={<Icon name="compose" />} onClick={newChat}>
            New chat
          </Button>
          {conversations.map((c) => (
            <ListItem
              key={c.id}
              title={c.title}
              meta={c.updated}
              selected={c.id === activeId}
              onClick={() => open(c.id)}
            />
          ))}
        </Stack>
      }
    >
      <Box paddingX={5} paddingY={3}>
        <Text weight="semibold" truncate>
          {active?.title ?? 'New chat'}
        </Text>
      </Box>
      {/* The list takes the remaining height and scrolls by itself */}
      <Stack grow>
        <MessageList
          ref={listRef}
          items={items}
          getKey={(m) => m.id}
          renderItem={renderTurn}
          streaming={generating}
          empty={
            <Stack gap={3} align="center">
              <Heading level={2}>How can I help?</Heading>
              <PromptSuggestions items={STARTERS} onSelect={(s) => send(s.label)} />
            </Stack>
          }
        />
      </Stack>
      <Stack padding={3}>
        <PromptInput
          generating={generating}
          onStop={reply.stop}
          onSubmit={(m) => send(m.text)}
          placeholder="Ask about plans, notes or updates"
        />
      </Stack>
    </SplitView>
  )
}
```
